info.name: NPS (Nigerian Payment Stack) API Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive API collection for the Nigerian Payment Stack system including all endpoints for payments, authentication, admin management, analytics, alerts, and system monitoring.

## Authentication Methods:
1. **Web Access**: Use email/password login to get JWT token for web application access
2. **Direct API Access**: Use X-API-Key header for direct API calls

## Default Admin Credentials:
- Email: admin@nps.payaza.com
- Password: Admin@123456
- API Key: admin_api_key_99999_secure_default
